$comment: Chunk contracts. Read by scripts/check-architecture.mjs (source: a lazy entry must not be statically reachable from src/index.tsx; every import() of an app module needs a contract here), scripts/check-chunk-graph.mjs (build/chunk-graph.json, written by vite build: forbidden modules, singletons, entries in their own chunk) and scripts/check-bundle-budget.sh (gzip budgets). `name` is the chunk's logical name — its filename up to the content hash. `entry` is a repo-relative module id (an exact file, or a node_modules prefix). `forbidden` are regular expressions over module ids; the main chunk also forbids every `entry` below. Add a contract when you add an import().

chunks.name: carModeRuntime
chunks.note: The car-mode runtime. three bump to a WebGPURenderer-capable release moved more of three's shared payload here (~108 KiB, was ~32 KiB). Do not statically import three/webgpu from it.

chunks.name: createCabinRenderer
chunks.note: The WebGPU cabin renderer; loads three/webgpu as its own further-lazy chunk.

chunks.name: AtmosphereController
chunks.note: The atmosphere LUT pass; absent at Low/Medium and opt-in above, so value imports of AtmosphereController stay out of main-bundle modules (AtmosphereLayer imports it lazily).

chunks.name: SemanticController
chunks.note: Value imports of SemanticController stay out of main-bundle modules (#352). onnxruntime-web is imported inside the depth Worker only.

chunks.name: three.webgpu
chunks.note: The node-material / TSL renderer, loaded by createCabinRenderer; inherently large. Skipped for ?cabin=webgl.

chunks.name: tz
chunks.note: Offline lat/lng → IANA zone for the in-car clock.

singletons.why: The eager renderer reads the cabin overlay the lazy car chunk publishes.
The lazy car chunk reads the road HDR frame the eager renderer publishes (the windshield portal's only road input).
Module-level capture state shared between the car runtime and its callers.

workers.name: depthWorker
workers.note: A few KB: onnxruntime-web is imported from a pinned CDN URL inside the Worker at run time, never bundled (#320).
